Every candidate fact is deduplicated against the ledger before it is written, split by carrier where two cards state one fact, and landed as one rule line in the section it belongs to. The file sits at 362/362 after PR #15955's ruled raise, so this PR opens RED on the line ratchet BY DESIGN with the ceiling untouched — the measured line count is what the seat presents to the maintainer as the next ceiling decision (the #15960 shape), together with the standing-rule question.

GOVERNED (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge, `skip-changeset`; at ACCEPT the seat adds `needs-user-decision` + the 维护者速读 and files the ceiling decision card.
The PR carries `Fixes #15977`.
